lines.text: Spend more than usual on fun.
I splurged on a nice dinner.

data.mean: Spend more than usual on fun.
data.define: To spend more money on a treat than you normally would.

example.text: I splurged on a nice dinner.

misuse.text: Don't say 'splurge' about a tiny snack.
misuse.why: It means spending lots, not little.

publish.title: What does "splurge" mean?
